description: Ministry of Ports Shipping and Aviation - Civil Aviation has Made the Regulation Act No. 14 of 2010
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the creation of new regulations under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It establishes legal requirements for En-route Navigation Facility Charges, including payment mechanisms, exemptions, and enforcement provisions. While it mentions a minister (Nimal Siripala De Silva), it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory framework he is establishing through his ministerial powers. The content fits the Legal/Regulatory category as it creates binding legal obligations and amends previous regulations.
